_comment: Emulate the syscall surface of a 4.9 kernel: every syscall listed here did NOT exist in Linux 4.9, and is forced to return ENOSYS (errnoRet 38). The container runtime (runc) itself needs statx/fsmount/fsconfig/fsopen/move_mount/open_tree to set up /proc, and seccomp is applied before that step, so those four cannot be blocked here -- they are covered by the fact that glibc only uses them behind ENOSYS fallbacks.
